The speaker tells the crowd about his political background, explaining that he grew up as a Democrat and had always considered himself a Democrat. He says that this was his political identity for most of his life before one experience caused him to rethink where he stood politically. Pointing toward Donald Trump, the speaker says that meeting him changed his perspective. He explains, “I grew up a Democrat, and I've always been a Democrat until I met this man right here,” making Trump the central reason he gives for his change in political outlook. He then makes a clear statement about his family’s future voting choices. Looking toward Trump, he says, “He will not have to worry about nobody in my family ever voting for a Democrat again, okay?” The statement goes beyond his own political choice and says that his family will no longer vote for Democratic candidates. The crowd responds with loud cheers and applause immediately after he makes the statement. What began as a personal account of growing up as a Democrat turns into a highly emotional moment as he publicly declares that his family has moved away from supporting the Democratic Party. The clip then transitions to music and on-screen commentary describing the moment as part of what it presents as a broader trend of people leaving the Democratic Party. The speaker’s story is presented as one example of a voter changing his political affiliation after meeting Trump and deciding that his family’s future votes will go in a different direction.    #DonaldTrump #DemocraticParty #PoliticalRealignment #USPolitics
